content.short: TruFin is an institutional-grade liquid staking protocol providing secure yield and staking infrastructure.
content.description: TruFin is a premier decentralized finance protocol designed to provide institutional and retail participants with secure staking and liquid staking solutions. The platform focuses on professional-grade risk management and regulatory alignment, offering a suite of products including TruStake, which allows users to earn staking rewards while maintaining capital liquidity through yield-bearing tokens. TruFin operates across major networks including NEAR and Polygon, serving as a vital bridge between traditional financial entities and the next generation of decentralized protocols.
